summary: QTREX Quantum Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on July 14, 2026, announcing a commercial purchase order from an international government-owned company for customized Shielded RF Monolithic components. No acquisition, divestiture, or special situation is involved; it is a routine business update about production and delivery within days. The press release describes expansion of the commercial model to direct supply of proprietary components. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisors are mentioned. This is an ordinary operational milestone, not a special situation. Watch for future orders under the follow-on program if disclosed in subsequent filings.
